description: This file defines functions and types for checking and reporting issues related to WhatsApp account statuses within a plugin SDK, including collecting issues based on account states and health.

classes.name: WhatsAppAccountStatus
classes.description: Type representing the status of a WhatsApp account with optional fields for various status indicators.

methods.name: readWhatsAppAccountStatus
methods.description: Reads and constructs a WhatsAppAccountStatus object from a ChannelAccountSnapshot, returning null if input is not a record.

methods.name: collectWhatsAppStatusIssues
methods.description: Collects and returns issues related to WhatsApp account statuses by analyzing account states and health, generating appropriate issue reports.
